statements:
CREATE TABLE "agent_chat_submission_inbox" (
  "thread_id" text NOT NULL,
  "message_id" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_email" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_auth_user_id" text,
  "actor_identity_authenticated_at_ms" bigint,
  "actor_name" text,
  "actor_org_id" text,
  "actor_org_scope" text,
  "actor_anonymous" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "payload_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "payload_json" text NOT NULL,
  "interrupt_active_run" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "submitted_run_id" text,
  "queue_order" bigint DEFAULT nextval('agent_chat_submission_inbox_queue_order_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL,
  "move_to_top_at" bigint,
  "retry_after" bigint,
  "created_at" bigint NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" bigint NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "agent_execution_leases" (
  "thread_id" text NOT NULL,
  "turn_id" text NOT NULL,
  "generation" bigint NOT NULL,
  "owner_run_id" text NOT NULL,
  "lease_expires_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "agent_execution_steps" (
  "thread_id" text NOT NULL,
  "turn_id" text NOT NULL,
  "step_id" text NOT NULL,
  "operation_id" text NOT NULL,
  "tool_name" text NOT NULL,
  "input_json" text NOT NULL,
  "replay_policy" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "run_id" text NOT NULL,
  "generation" bigint NOT NULL,
  "result_json" text,
  "receipt_json" text,
  "error_json" text,
  "dispatched_at" timestamp with time zone,
  "completed_at" timestamp with time zone,
  "created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "agent_runs" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "thread_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'running'::text NOT NULL,
  "abort_reason" text,
  "started_at" bigint NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" bigint,
  "heartbeat_at" bigint,
  "last_progress_at" bigint,
  "turn_id" text,
  "error_code" text,
  "error_detail" text,
  "terminal_reason" text,
  "dispatch_mode" text,
  "diag_stage" text,
  "dispatch_payload" text,
  "peak_rss_mb" bigint,
  "continuation_order" bigint,
  "thread_projection_pending" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "worker_stage" text,
  "in_flight_since" bigint,
  "auto_continue_of" text,
  "worker_generation" bigint
);

CREATE TABLE "agent_tool_ledger" (
  "thread_id" text NOT NULL,
  "tool_key" text NOT NULL,
  "result_summary" text NOT NULL,
  "result_is_string" boolean,
  "artifacts_json" text,
  "chat_ui_result_json" text,
  "completed_at" bigint NOT NULL,
  "arguments_hash" text
);

CREATE TABLE "chat_thread_shares" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" text NOT NULL,
  "principal_type" text NOT NULL,
  "principal_id" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'viewer'::text NOT NULL,
  "created_by" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" text DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "notified_at" text
);

CREATE TABLE "chat_threads" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "owner_email" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text DEFAULT ''::text NOT NULL,
  "preview" text DEFAULT ''::text NOT NULL,
  "thread_data" text DEFAULT '{}'::text NOT NULL,
  "message_count" bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" bigint NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" bigint NOT NULL,
  "scope_type" text,
  "scope_id" text,
  "scope_label" text,
  "pinned_at" bigint,
  "archived_at" bigint,
  "share_token_hash" text,
  "source_platform" text,
  "source_app_id" text,
  "source_url" text,
  "org_id" text,
  "visibility" text DEFAULT 'private'::text NOT NULL
);
ALTER TABLE "agent_chat_submission_inbox" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_chat_submission_inbox_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, message_id);
ALTER TABLE "agent_execution_leases" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_execution_leases_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, turn_id);
ALTER TABLE "agent_execution_steps" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_execution_steps_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, turn_id, step_id);
ALTER TABLE "agent_run_events" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_run_events_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (run_id, seq);
ALTER TABLE "agent_runs" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_runs_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE "agent_tool_ledger" ADD CONSTRAINT "agent_tool_ledger_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, tool_key);
ALTER TABLE "chat_thread_shares" ADD CONSTRAINT "chat_thread_shares_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE "chat_threads" ADD CONSTRAINT "chat_threads_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id);
